source.map: Map 7.1 Local Street Connectivity, page 10 of the Raleigh Hills - Garden Home Community Plan maps (https://washingtoncountyor.gov/lut/planning/documents/raleigh-hills-garden-home-community-plan-maps-08-2026/download, retrieved 2026-10-30, sha256 68b540cffc579ea27c1fe1493571175b093d7022fbb4f6065adb1e6777cdf50d) and page 10 of the Bull Mountain Community Plan maps (https://washingtoncountyor.gov/lut/planning/documents/bull-mountain-community-plan-maps/download, retrieved 2026-10-30, sha256 35470f9e0026fbc4bff869b42a23777c4f75b92face5fb8360a625e8a72d9746). Both sheets are printed 9/20/2022.

inputs.taxlots: Washington County taxlots FeatureServer (gispub.co.washington.or.us/server/rest/services/Washington_County_Taxlots/FeatureServer/0), each plan's boundary envelope, fetched 2026-10-30: Raleigh Hills 10569 lots (sha256 6bcbdf6572c06f58...), Bull Mountain 18647 (bea1585ef3757bf2...)
inputs.zoning: Washington County Land Use Districts (LUT_PDS/Planning_Layers/MapServer/0), same envelopes, fetched 2026-10-30; a lot takes the district covering most of it
inputs.unincorporated: Washington County Unincorporated Area (LUT_PDS/Base_Layers/MapServer/27); a lot counts when at least half of it is unincorporated land inside the plan boundary

source.traced_by: Claude (districts-c7 worker, FOLLOWUPS 109 chunk 7, coordinator ruling 2026-10-30)
source.how: Each sheet's Local_Street map frame carries a GeoPDF /VP viewport with its corner coordinates (NAD83 HARN geographic, projected to EPSG:2913); a page-to-ground affine was fitted to them. Bull Mountain's sheet is a raster and Raleigh Hills' carries the same fill as vector paths, so both were read one way: the page rendered at 432 dpi (4.63 ft a pixel), the 'Local Street Connectivity Lands' green (R 40-140, G > 200, B < 80) masked inside the main frame (legend and inset excluded), the mask closed by 3 pixels to fill the taxlot lines the map draws over it, and each pixel placed by the frame's affine. A residential lot's share is the masked ground over its area 6 ft in from its lines (so a pixel lost at the lot line is not read as the map's edge): at least 90 percent is inside, held whole; more than 10 percent and less is cut, carried as its masked part (pixel gaps closed by 3 ft and simplified at 3 ft) at its share, so the screen leaves it unanswered; a cut lot whose part falls within 12 percent of either band edge is carried whole instead, so it is held and never read as outside. Inside means the plan's on-site street standards reach the lot's development (Bull Mountain: block lengths of 530 ft, perimeters of 1,800 ft, no cul-de-sacs, connection to stub streets; Raleigh Hills: Local Streets required to connect, or accessways where impracticable), and an on-site street takes ground nothing measures.
